steps.content: A few days later...

steps.speaker: Mechanical Sound
steps.content: Beep—High speed detected. Please do not run in the Bureau unless in an emergency. Please adhere to safety protocols...
A shadow darts through the corridor, rushes to the Chief's office, and starts pounding on the door.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Chief... Chief, come out and make things right, waaah...
You ignore the cries for help at the door, but the cry grows more pitiful, as if to drown out the entire Bureau.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Chief, Chief, open the door... I know you're in there...
The shrill wails are truly torturous to the ears.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...Fine.
You open the door and see a crowd gathered outside, all of them looking as indignant as EMP.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Chief... You have to help me this time...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: The comic books I just bought yesterday... I saved them to fully enjoy today and found that someone had gone through them already!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Rumina
Flipping through the pages, you indeed see a bright circle around a certain NPC's head, annotated with the words "Big Villain" and a cheeky cat face.
...This face looks oddly familiar.

steps.speaker: Sad Employee
steps.content: The report I wrote yesterday... this morning, I found it annotated in red, with a big "CHECK" scrawled on top!

steps.speaker: Angry Employee
steps.content: And me! The files I submitted to Adjutant Nightingale yesterday was replaced with... well, something I can't let her see. My days are limited...
EMP's complaints resonate with many around her. After listening to all their grievances, you realize all of them are victims of the cheeky cat's pranks.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: It's my new collector's edition of "Detective Konan" for heaven's sake!

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Umm... so only one volume is spoiled?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: ...Ohhhhh wait...
EMP shakily pulls out another volume from her bag and slowly opens it. Sure enough, there's another big red circle.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: ...I, I'll kill you...!!!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Damn it... That nasty, evil cat! I swear I'll hunt her down and make her pay for this!!!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Chief, you're not shielding that girl just because she looks helpless, right? Don't be a chump! You can't just randomly bring strays home!!!!

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...Nonsense.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Anyway, I'll help you find the culprit. Leave it to me.
After finally appeasing the victims, you turn around and spot a little kitty crouching at the door.
You crouch down as well and hold the kitty's paw.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: The system error, EMP's comic books, the reports and task files—you've caused them quite a bit of trouble.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Come on, time to turn yourself in, would you?
Hehe, your Sinners are much more fun to tease than you.
The real culprit peeks out from the doorway, a gloating smile on her face.
Three minutes ago, 000 hurriedly slipped into your office, demanding that you "shelter" her for a while.
Puzzled in the first place, now you fully understand what she means. She picked a great spot to watch the show.

options: Aren't you going to face them?

choices.text: Aren't you going to face them?

steps.content: Nah. Why would the culprit reveal herself? That's just asking for trouble.
You are not gonna betray me, are you?

options: But it's fine to come to me?

choices.text: But it's fine to come to me?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: In a way, I'm also a victim. Aren't you afraid I'll team up with them?
Well... there's a reason for that...
The girl freezes and averts her gaze.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You pull pranks everywhere, and peep at their reactions... If you really want to play with them, why not just ask directly?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You claim to be a "loner," but you seem to be having a lot of fun.
...Hmph!
000 stops arguing, shuts her mouth tightly, and turns to leave.
After reaching the hallway, she quickly turns around, makes a face at you, and runs off.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Now what should I do with you...

steps.speaker: Little Kitty
steps.content: Kitty Shadow
The "stray" you detained is far from well-behaved. She caused quite a bit of trouble around the Bureau, but nothing too serious, just attention-seeking pranks.
Since that's the case, let her be stubborn for a bit longer. You think for a moment, then decide to do a good deed. You pull out your phone and send EMP a message.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: You rascal... I see you! I'll make you pay for those spoilers! Pay me for my comics!!!
You withhold your grin and close the door, satisfied.
After finishing your work, you close your eyes to take a nap, but 000's guilty gaze and snicker float into your mind.
You can feel a subtle understanding and closeness between you two, but she's definitely hiding something. Whenever you probe deeper, she avoids you with a peculiar attitude.
What is she hiding? What is she stopping you from investigating?
You ponder strategies until fatigue overtakes you, and you drift off to sleep.
[Scene transition, Chief's white dream]

steps.speaker: Faint Voice
steps.content: ...Come closer...
The girl's chuckle echoes in your ears. You open your eyes wide, trying to find her.
Strangely, no matter how hard you try, it feels like a heavy curtain is covering your vision. You can only see a hazy glow and nothing else.
You reach out, but there's only emptiness ahead.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I can hear your voice... You're close.
You realize something and start feeling around your face. Surely, someone is gently covering your eyes from behind.

options: What are you trying to tell me?

choices.text: What are you trying to tell me?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You sneak into my dreams every night but never let me see your face... What do you want to tell me? Who are you?
The dream begins to disintegrate. You try to grasp her, but you feel her hands dissolving into pieces.

steps.speaker: Girl in the Dream
steps.content: ...Come find me...

steps.speaker: Girl in the Dream
steps.content: ...You must... find me!
[Black Screen]
Hey, what are you mumbling about?
[Scene transition, break room]
You open your eyes and find yourself back in the familiar room.
000's wagging her head before you. For a moment, she overlaps with the blurry figure in your dream, but quickly becomes clear again.
I just came in. It wasn't hard to unlock the door.
You were blabbering loudly in your sleep just now, saying stuff like, "Who are you?" Who were you dreaming about? How come you were so riled up?
You instinctively recall the dream you just had, but as your vision clears, the figure in the dream dissipates, and your memory of it becomes too vague to grasp.
You look up and see a surprisingly serious expression on her face. Her eyes sparkle with curiosity and confusion, as if she genuinely wants an answer from you.
Hmph, what a lame answer. If you don't want to say, fine... I'm not forcing you.
Fortunately, 000 doesn't dwell on it for long, her attention quickly shifting to the various trinkets on your desk.
You rarely have time to put away the things the Sinners bring you, so they usually end up piled in the corner of your desk. 000 rummages around and finds some sparklers.
You confiscate the dangerous items, but 000 remains undeterred. She continues to fiddle around, occasionally asking you related questions, quite interested.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: How's life at the Bureau? Everything good?
Hmm... Though someone's always watching my every move, the people here are way more fun than those outside.
I guess it's alright.
000 nonchalantly leans back in your chair, her attention now entirely on the various interesting gadgets in front of her.
But you don't feel as relaxed as she does.
...Next to 000's hand, a brand-new investigation report lies on your desk.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, the Intelligence Department has collected key information about the past of Sinner 000. As it turns out, it isn't she who utilized the dark web to commit crimes. The culprit is someone else.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I've emailed the file to you. You can check it at your convenience, Chief.
You had Nightingale secretly investigate 000's past. Now, this information lies on your desk.

█ Number: MBCC-SS-000-0807114
█ File: Follow-up Investigation Report on Sinner 000

...It has been confirmed that the incident involving the subject's parents in N.F. 108 was not accidental. Shortly afterwards, the subject was forcibly adopted under a fake identity.

It is suspected that both incidents were orchestrated by the same entity, possibly an underground criminal organization. Further details remain under investigation...
Most Sinners are mad; some madness stems from malice, and some from misfortune. 000 is clearly the latter, which makes it a heartbreaking case.
But the moment you see this file, you feel a strong sense of discord.

The uneasy feeling that has been building up since your first meeting with her reaches a boiling point. Even though this investigation report was brought back by a trusted colleague, you can't help but question it.
This suspicion doesn't come from reason... but from your intuition.
If an investigation can't dispel your doubts, then it's better to just ask her directly.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: They... found out something about your past. You are also a victim, and we've found the real culprit.
The moment you finish, the room falls into silence.
000 freezes. With her back to you, her face is hidden in the shadows, making it hard to read her emotions.
...Humph, I'm listening. You found the criminal and cleared my name. That's great.
She turns back, her smile distant, returning to the absent-minded look she had when you first met.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: If you're unhappy with how we handled the follow-up of this matter, you can tell me. The MBCC will fight for your rights.
Why would I be upset? You did a thorough background check and follow-up. Keep it up.
She takes another step forward, completely stepping into the light.
Great. Your wish has come true.
Getting close to Sinners, prying into their past, earning their trust... Does that make you happy? I can also be one of the wretches you rescue.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Do you see me as that kind of person?
000 lets out a noncommittal hum.
Of course you don't mean it. You're the kind Chief who treats all Sinners equally. The problem lies with me, being ungrateful and not appreciating your kindness.
Go ahead, continue investigating, do whatever you want...
I don't care.
Her words are sharp, each one stabbing straight at you.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...I don't see you as a weak person.
Silence falls, and neither of you can find a word to continue the conversation.
This lasts until the comms device lights up again. It's an action confirmation from Nightingale.
You look down to check. When you look up again, the person in front of you has left, leaving the room in a heavy silence that continues to weigh down on your heart.
Granted. It's time to take some action.
